I added both buttons below the list. The script's syntax checks out, but I haven't tested it in a browser.
Both buttons act on every todo, not only the ones the current filter or search shows. They only mark or remove todos and never move them, so the page still sorts active todos above completed ones, then by priority, then by the order you added them.
I didn't make the buttons work only on visible todos, and I didn't make "mark all" switch back to incomplete when every todo is already done.
